answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using TPM remote attestation with zero-knowledge nullifiers. Each agent proves possession of a vendor-signed endorsement key to a nectar verifier, which checks it against a shale root list and logs a unique nullifier to stop clones across an ocean of VMs. Attackers must buy scarce physical silicon per identity instead of copying containers. However, side-channel key extraction from one chip still lets adversaries mint spoofed identities.
